_doc: Local LLM T0.5 tier parameters — controls routing quality, context, and inference

max_ctx.doc: Maximum word count of context sent to the local model. Higher = more complete but slower.

quality_threshold.doc: Minimum response word count to pass the quality gate. Higher = stricter fallback to Anthropic.

rag_top_k.doc: BM25 RAG chunks prepended to local LLM context. 0 = disabled.

two_stage.doc: Two-stage mode: Anthropic plan + local execution for refactor/codegen tasks.

model.doc: Ollama model to use for T0.5 inference. 7b is ~2x faster, 14b has higher RQS-LLM.
